status: In progress; core inheritance tested, visuals not accepted
scope: Inherited biological variation, individual and regional
Species size and morphology distinct from peoples/culture
Persistent people identity independent of political ownership

research.application: UV-related pigmentation selection, not a temperature-to-race lookup; diet and migration matter.
Continuous polygenic iris pigmentation; no single eye-colour gene or fixed skin/eye package.
Polygenic stature plus growth conditions; population means and individual ranges must remain separate.
Migration and population turnover; modern continental appearance packages are not timeless Paleolithic presets.
Small-bodied human species baseline; no 1m ordinary sapiens ethnic-group mean.
Hair morphology inheritance; avoid attributing every visible trait to one simple environmental adaptation.

limits: No asserted wind/plateau cause for eyelid morphology. Eyelid folds are ancestry/individual morph variation.
Stochastic game distributions are plausible procedural parameters, not a reconstruction of named present-day peoples.
